summary: Multi-language implementation plan covering 5 languages (Kannada + Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam). Analyzes 2,115 lines of Kannada text across 41 files, categorized into astrological terms, UI labels, and domain content. Proposes a 3-phase approach: infrastructure (AppLocale + strings), settings UI, then screen-by-screen migration. Includes open questions about fonts, places, priority order, and PDF support.
